name: Star Creation Incremental [BETA]
desc:
Star Creation Incremental

A game where you collect Star Essence on a field.
But the more you progress, you will reach higher numbers and new features!

(the collecting feature is very original i know)

Game is recommended for devices such as computers or laptops.

HIGHLY Inspired by: Grass Cutting Incremental (Made by @LethalDolphin) 
Also Inspired by: Atomic Incremental (Made by @S4ndieYT)

Game Icon & Thumbnail Made by: @invert53
Galaxy Music Made by: @Dark_D04 (or Gun)

scripts.title: Collect Stars
scripts.features: - Collect Stars (Must be in the field of the stars)
